name: Omarchy Discord
author: Matt Calayo
description: Discord client for Omarchy with text chat, voice and experimental H.264 screen and camera viewing.

barWidget.description: Discord mark with a mention badge and quick microphone mute. Left click opens your current voice room during calls or the conversation list otherwise; right click opens the window; middle click runs the configured quick action.

schema.label: Stay connected
schema.description: On keeps the backend connected while the plugin is enabled so mentions keep arriving. Off disconnects when no Discord surface has been open for a while.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Which messages raise a desktop notification through the Omarchy notification center.

schema.label: Show mention count in bar
schema.description: Show the number of unread mentions next to the bar mark.

schema.label: Middle click on the bar mark
schema.description: Quick action for a middle click on the bar widget.

schema.label: Window
schema.description: Persistent keeps the client window mapped from shell start so Hyprland rules can place it (e.g. the scratchpad); SUPER+D then focuses or hides it.

schema.label: Image previews
schema.description: Show image attachments through the bounded Discord media cache. File links remain available if a preview cannot load.

schema.label: Media cache size (MB)
schema.description: Upper bound for cached avatars, emoji, and attachments under the user cache directory.
